steps.description:
Enhance and improve on your Basic 1 Project Codes by applying the following concepts
1. Variables
- Must perform changes to variable values during execution (i.e. variable should not just store a value and remain fixed throughout)

2. List
- Should contain more than 1 item in a list
- Should not just simply display the whole list. Must at least read an individual item from list or perform an update on list values during execution.

3. Function
- Should not have just one block in a function.
- Functions are highly recommended for a repeatedly executed groups of codes or to breakdown long codes into meaning tasks (one function per task)

4. Random Numbers
- Use the random number to give your code random/unpredictable outcome (i.e. to avoid hard coding)

5. Add a comment at the starting block to describe how each of the concepts has enhanced the project
Create a flowchart of the previous step
